description: An archive updated in place (spec § 2.3). A pending job (structure, job.spec, a run.record holding the prepared input, provenance.run_status 'pending') was written with its manifest last; a runner then appended the run's log, a rewritten run.record files index under a new name (run/files.2.json), Mulliken charges and a new manifest.json, and wrote a new central directory listing every entry. The archive therefore holds two manifest.json entries: the last is the manifest (run_status 'converged', metadata.modified_utc set, created_utc and uuid kept), the first is superseded. The superseded manifest and run/files.json are orphans, so a validator reports W_ORPHAN_MEMBER twice and no error; E_ZIP_DUPLICATE_ENTRY does not apply to manifest.json. The new manifest references the kept entries (structure, job.spec, the input) and the appended ones. A consumer that reads the first manifest.json sees run_status 'pending' and fails the checks.
